data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month and invite each of the other 24 to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. Versus 10, 18 earns $8,000 extra if filled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). Assumes those catches; other choices require recalculation. This risks future income, not guaranteed optimal. Intentions aren't binding. Each person: state your exact intended catch and whether it depends on others.
